children: Southern Company plans to sell 35M equity units at $50 each, for $1.75B aggregate stated amount, with an expected underwriters’ option for 5M additional units worth $250M. Proceeds are intended partly for convertible-note repurchases and debt repayment; no prior-period comparison was provided.
The equity-linked issuance may dilute shareholders; final pricing and terms are not yet disclosed.
Underwriters may buy 5M extra units, or $250M
The option could increase the offering size, but is solely for covering over-allotments.
Proceeds may repurchase 2024A notes due June 2027
The company expects to use part of the proceeds for debt repurchases, but gives no amount or assurance of completion.
Remaining proceeds for debt and corporate purposes
Debt repayment is planned, while investments and general corporate uses leave the allocation unspecified.

This is a financing and capital-structure update, rather than an operating-results disclosure. Pricing, final offering size, and the amount of notes repurchased would clarify dilution and the net effect on debt.
